Crit.hitChartsHint: Attack results by armor (NA / LA / MA / HA)
Crit.severityHint: Roll d100 with VsD crit severity modifier (Sup +0 … Let +50). Look up the total on the table yourself.

Conditions.chatToggleHint: Post a chat message when token conditions are added or removed.

Audit.sheetWhisper: Whisper sheet stat/skill changes to GM
Audit.sheetWhisperHint: When enabled, non-GM edits to PC stats, saves, skills, custom skills, and spell lores send a private chat message to all GMs.
Audit.driveHeroWhisperHint: When enabled, non-GM changes to Drive or Hero points send a private chat message to all GMs.

Phases.enabledHint: Let PCs toggle planned action phases on the Combat tab; badges appear on the combat tracker.
Phases.visibilityHint: Who can see phase badges on the combat tracker.
Phases.clearOnRoundHint: When a new combat round starts, clear all PC phase toggles (GM only).
Phases.sortHint: Set initiative from declared phases (higher phase acts first). Suggestion only.
Phases.gmOnly: Only a GM can sort combat by phase.

Combat.woundReminderPlayersHint: When a combatant's turn starts, also whisper bleed/penalty totals to that actor's owners.
Combat.defeatedNudgeHint: Show a notification when HP drops to 0 (does not apply Defeated automatically).
Combat.tokenHpHudHint: Show GM-only −5/−1/+1/+5 buttons on the token HUD for HP.

Bestiary.autoImportHint: When enabled, creates NPC actors from the bundled bestiary the first time this world is opened by a GM.
Bestiary.importHint: Create (or refresh) NPC actors from the bundled Against the Darkmaster bestiary into an Actor folder named VsD Bestiary.
Bestiary.forceUpdate: Update existing monsters with the same name
Bestiary.gmOnly: Only a GM can import the bestiary.
Bestiary.alreadyImported: Bestiary already imported for this world.

MerpBestiary.autoImportHint: When enabled, creates NPC actors from the MERP CE ST-2 conversion into an Actor folder named MERP. Off by default.
MerpBestiary.importHint: Create (or refresh) NPC actors converted from MERP Collector's Edition ST-2 into an Actor folder named MERP.
MerpBestiary.copyrightHint: MERP stats are ICE copyright — for private use with books you own.
MerpBestiary.gmOnly: Only a GM can import MERP creatures.
MerpBestiary.alreadyImported: MERP creatures already imported for this world.
MerpBestiary.loadFailed: Could not load MERP creature data.
